idiom_name: interface + typed client class over fetch, returning typed DTOs
implementation_notes: Declare an interface for the operations the UI needs and implement it with a class (or an object of functions) that receives the transport in its constructor, builds URLs, sets headers, checks response.ok and decodes JSON into typed DTOs; structural typing means a module of functions satisfies the same interface, and generated clients (OpenAPI codegen, tRPC) can implement the same seam. What replaces the classic structure: the interface type plus constructor injection is the whole delegate - consumers import the interface type, never the transport - and a discriminated-union Result can replace exceptions where callers must handle failure exhaustively.
pitfalls: as Invoice is unchecked at runtime - validate the payload (zod/valibot) or the delegate passes malformed remote data into typed code.
Use import type for interface-only imports, or transport modules get pulled into bundles that only need the type.
fetch has no timeout and no automatic retry; wire AbortSignal and backoff inside the delegate, not at every call site.
